agent_note: Third-person past-tense literary novel with several focalizers (Anna, Dexter, Eddie). 53 of 53 event quotes are past; no present event-narration at all. Only 5 gnomic quotes, all genuinely present-tense aphorisms or fragments. Several quotes that 'sound general' (q02180, q02183, q02205, q02224, q02243) are past-tense free indirect generalization about the story world and are filed event/past per METHODOLOGY's rule that gnomic is present-only -- this is the exact error direction the spec warns about. Mixed scene quotes were decided by word count under the quotation-mark-majority precedence rule; q02193, q02209 and q02226 are the close calls and are noted individually. Prose, not verse. No single quote would flip the label; the book is unambiguously past.
